---
title: "Containers"
---

A computational environment records the software your work needs. Containers and services such as Binder help others run that work in a consistent environment. These pads will begin with the shared ideas, then give separate instructions where Python and R need different setup.

## Planned pads

1. Understand computational environments and containers
2. Describe the dependencies for your Python or R project
3. Share a runnable project with Binder
4. Build and share a container image

While these pads are being prepared, explore the existing LeapFROGS materials for [Python](https://github.com/LinkedEarth/LeapFROGS/blob/main/chapters/module6.md) or [R](https://github.com/LinkedEarth/RLeapFROGS/blob/main/chapters/module6.md).
